papers.title: Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling
papers.authors: Zhefeng Huang, Yilin Cai, Ankit Patel, Mohammad Hajiha, Brendan Browne, Yue Chen
papers.abstract: Introduces FoMo-FD (Flow-Matching World Model for Failure Detection): uses flow-matching world model to detect failures in imitation-learning surgical robot policies, addressing scarce failure data, variable manipulation dynamics, and balancing missed detections vs. disruptive false alarms for safe deployment in safety-critical surgical tasks.

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Behavior-Aligned Representations
papers.authors: Ajay Sridhar, Jensen Gao, Jonathan Yang, Jean Mercat, Suneel Belkhale, Dorsa Sadigh
papers.abstract: Studies role of behavior-aligned representations (object bounding boxes, language motions, end-effector traces of robot motion) in vision-language-action (VLA) models to promote cross-embodiment transfer. Hypothesizes representations invariant across embodiments while predictive of robot actions improve transfer. Examines how these representations enable VLA models to bridge embodiment gaps in large-scale imitation learning.

papers.title: X-NavDP: Generalizing Navigation Diffusion Policy to Novel Behavior and Embodiments with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching
papers.authors: Tianyu Yang, Yiming Zeng, Wenzhe Cai, Yuqiang Yang, Jiaqi Peng, Hui Cheng, Jiangmiao Pang, Tai Wang
papers.abstract: Pretraining navigation diffusion policies relies on large-scale expert demonstrations from a fully-informed oracle planner suited to a single nominal robot, limiting generalization to diverse embodiments and challenging scenarios (dead ends, long detours) needing diverse local reactive behaviors with onboard local observations. Proposes RL post-training with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching to improve navigation diffusion policy generalization to novel behaviors and embodiments.

papers.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics
papers.authors: Jin Cao, Zian Meng, Kaipeng Zhang
papers.abstract: ShadowDancer enables any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models via 'shadow pairs' (video pairs replaying same dynamics under resampled appearance) and cross-shadow prediction. Learns a unified dynamics representation in a block-causal world model; any demonstrated clip becomes a reusable action asset replayed in new scenes without action labels, motion estimators, or fine-tuning. 86% average blinded win rate in rollout comparisons vs latent-action and interactive WM baselines.

papers.title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
papers.authors: Shuyao Shang, Yuqi Wang, Ruopeng Gao, Xu Chen, Tieniu Tan, Lue Fan, Zhaoxiang Zhang
papers.abstract: PhiZero introduces 'physical language', a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions, learned self-supervised from in-the-wild videos. Adopts reason-then-render paradigm: infers future evolution as physical-language sequence, then renders to video. Enables physically coherent world evolution, realistic interactive modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.

papers.title: RedFlow: Redirect Failure into Action-Level Corrections for Flow-matching VLA Policies
papers.authors: Zhengyang Yan, Junhao Li, Fangqi Zhu, Zijun Wang, Quanxin Shou, Yikun Miao, Xiaoyi Pang, Zicong Hong, Song Guo
papers.abstract: RedFlow is a fine-grained offline RL framework that redirects failure experiences into action-level corrective supervision for flow-matching VLA policies. Combines Context-Aware Corrective Matching (identifies failure-inducing actions, retrieves successful alternatives as corrective targets) with an Adaptive Redirection Objective. Improves real-world success rate from 56.7% to 74.7% on LIBERO + 3 real manipulation tasks, matching on-policy PPO/GRPO/DDPO with ~10x fewer samples.

papers.title: QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization
papers.authors: Zhoushun Yu, Xiaoyu Hu, Xiangyu Xu
papers.abstract: QQWorld replaces LeWorldModel's Epps-Pulley (EP) latent regularization with quantile-quantile matching that aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, maintaining corrective gradients in heavy tails. Adds cross-batch QQ enlarging the ranking pool via detached previous-batch samples. Improves planning success rate of LeWM across four control environments with better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

papers.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
papers.authors: Dongxiu Liu, Haoyi Niu, Peng Cheng, Yuan Gao, Xirui Kang, Sangli Teng, Koushil Sreenath, Xianyuan Zhan
papers.abstract: ODEWorld learns a continuous latent velocity field (PT-Flow) operating in physical time, with dynamics parameterized by an ODE in latent space. Prediction becomes temporal integration via an ODE solver. Addresses representation collapse in latent WMs, supports arbitrary temporal resolution and backward prediction, and provides planning-oriented information for policy learning. Excels in both video generation and robotic control.

papers.title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.authors: Xiangcheng Zhang, Yilun Du
papers.abstract: World Action Planner leverages action-conditioned world models for generalizable decision-making. Uses world model rollouts to evaluate and select actions across tasks without task-specific training, targeting zero-shot generalization of world-model-based planning across embodiments and environments.

papers.title: FA-RDP: A Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.authors: Lifeng Zhuo, Wendi Chen, Han Xue, Shirun Tang, Jun Lv
papers.abstract: FA-RDP is a frequency-adaptive reactive diffusion policy for contact-rich manipulation, adapting policy frequency to contact dynamics to maintain stability under reactive/high-bandwidth manipulation settings.

papers.title: Towards Real-Time PixOOD: Efficient Anomaly Segmentation for Autonomous Vehicles
papers.authors: Luca de Martino, Federico Aromolo, Federico Nesti, Giorgio Buttazzo
papers.abstract: Real-time efficient anomaly/out-of-distribution segmentation for autonomous vehicle perception, targeting deployment-time inference cost reduction while maintaining PixOOD-level detection quality.

papers.title: AuricularWorld: Hierarchical Action-Guided World Modeling for Fine-Grained Auricular Reasoning
papers.authors: Jingwen Yang, Senmao Wang, Luoyao Kang, Runmeng Cui, Keying Zhang
papers.abstract: AuricularWorld applies hierarchical action-guided world modeling to fine-grained auricular (ear/medicine) reasoning, extending action-conditioned world model ideas to specialized domain reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Security of World-Model-Based Embodied AI: A Lifecycle of Threats, Defenses, and Open Challenges
papers.authors: Fazhong Liu, Zhuoyan Chen, Haozhen Tan, Yan Meng, Guoxing Chen
papers.abstract: Survey on security of world-model-based embodied AI across the lifecycle: threat models (perception, planning, control attacks), defense mechanisms, and open challenges. Relevant to robustness of world models in autonomous driving and robotics.

papers.title: FinSMART: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Market-Aligned Learning
papers.authors: Giorgos Iacovides, Wuyang Zhou, Danilo Mandic
papers.abstract: FinSMART performs financial sentiment analysis for algorithmic trading via market-aligned learning, aligning model supervision with market-movement signals rather than raw labels to improve trading-relevant sentiment prediction.

papers.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
papers.authors: Hengyi Xie, Chenfei Yao, Xianjin Wu, Xuanyang Xi, Yiping Tang, Di Xu, Yingying Zhu, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai, Han Ding
papers.abstract: TurboVLA reformulates the conventional V->L->A pathway as a direct V+L->A mapping, independently encoding visual observations and language instructions with lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction and compact action decoder. Achieves 97.7% success on LIBERO with 0.2B params, 31.2ms latency, 0.9GB VRAM on RTX 4090.

papers.title: Mitigating Compounding Error via Video Representation Regularization
papers.authors: Taiye Chen, Qi Zhang, Yisen Wang
papers.abstract: Investigates internal representation dynamics of video diffusion world models, discovers compounding error is coupled with dimensional collapse of hidden representations. Proposes video representation regularization to stabilize latent representations. Improves Aesthetic Quality from 38.65 to 55.56 on VBench.

papers.title: HeteroPROMPT: A Real-time and Privacy-Preserving Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception Framework
papers.authors: Armin Maleki, Hayder Radha
papers.abstract: Privacy-preserving collaborative perception framework aligning heterogeneous agents' BEV features via modular prompts. Lightweight tuning with frozen encoders/fusion. Improves AP over SOTA on OPV2V-H and V2XSet with orders-of-magnitude fewer trainable params.

papers.title: DVPSFormer: Efficient Online Depth-aware Video Panoptic Segmentation for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yung-Hsu Yang, Luigi Piccinelli, Siyuan Li, Mattia Segu, Lei Ke
papers.abstract: Unified online architecture for depth-aware video panoptic segmentation. Explicit scene discretization (ESD) with discrete-to-continuous depth head. SOTA on Cityscapes-DVPS and SemKITTI-DVPS benchmarks.

papers.title: Controlled Experiments on Lane Changing by Transitional Autonomous Vehicle: Dataset and Behavioral Insights
papers.authors: Abhinav Sharma, Md Abdullah Al Hasan, Danjue Chen, George F. List
papers.abstract: NC-tALC dataset: controlled field experiments on mandatory lane-changing behavior of transitional AVs. 78 lane-change trials on public road, RTK-GNSS/INS trajectories, lead-lag gap analysis, surrogate safety measures.

papers.title: Object Detection for Autonomous Driving in Chinese Rural Scenes: An Experimental Study on Real-Synthetic Data Mixing
papers.authors: Danning Zhu, Ziyan Lin, Jing Wu
papers.abstract: Real-synthetic mixed object detection dataset for Chinese rural roads. Evaluates 13 detectors (YOLO series, RT-DETR) with 14-category system including electric tricycles, low-speed vehicles. YOLO11m achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.758.

papers.title: NeoRacer: An Open, Standardized 1:12 Scale Autonomous Race Car for Benchmarking and Education
papers.authors: Koneshka Bandyopadhyay, Ansh Mehta, Bassel El Mabsout, Renato Mancuso
papers.abstract: Open-source 1:12 scale autonomous racing platform: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (67 TOPS), 270° LiDAR, 120fps global-shutter camera, 9-axis IMU. Pre-assembled for USD 2,699, 3x compute of comparable platforms at half the cost.

papers.title: Practice Makes Policies: Bootstrapping Robotic Capabilities from Zero Human Demonstrations
papers.authors: Jialiang Li, Yuhan Wang, Haojun Li, Gaojing Zhang, Yangtian Ye
papers.abstract: HERO: self-improving hierarchical embodied agent for autonomous capability evolution without human demos. Heuristic reasoning, exemplar reuse, reflexive execution in unified framework for continuous skill improvement.

papers.title: Risk-Aware Motion Planning with Learned Trajectory Primitives and Probabilistic Safety Assessment
papers.authors: Marc Kaufeld, Dian Zhuang, Johannes Betz
papers.abstract: RBFN-informed motion planning for urban autonomous driving. Combines learned jerk-minimal trajectory primitives with analytic collision probability assessment and MPC refinement. Improved risk awareness vs benchmarks.

papers.title: Physically Real-time Infrared Attack against Optical Flow Estimation Networks
papers.authors: Shen You, Wei Jiang, Jiarui Liu, Yijian Ye, Qiuzhen Lin
papers.abstract: Real-time adversarial attack on optical flow networks using infrared lights in physical world. Generates AEs dynamically, attacks victim models directly. Compromises OFENs across varying lighting and motion conditions.

papers.title: Mental World Modeling
papers.authors: Hao Fei, Yiran Zhao
papers.abstract: Theoretical framework extending world models to include hidden mental states (beliefs, intents, feelings). MENTIS baseline: training-free, inspectable system for modeling mental-physical coupled states in decision scenarios.

papers.title: VidMap: Exploiting Temporal Structure for Video-Based Structure-from-Motion
papers.authors: Zador Pataki, Paul-Edouard Sarlin, Marc Pollefeys
papers.abstract: Bridges SLAM and SfM for metric reconstruction of arbitrary uncalibrated videos. Uses sequential constraints + global optimization. More robust than SOTA SLAM and SfM on challenging datasets with extreme motion.
